arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE transparent full-body cartoon sprite based on the FIRST image, an exact enlarged pixel-art pose. The SECOND image is ONLY the shared character identity/material/style reference, NOT its walking pose. Keep the source's exact facing, head angle, arm/hand positions and standing leg/foot silhouette. Same adult small worker: black cap, dark short hair, tan face/hands, bright green long-sleeve shirt, royal blue bib overalls, dark shoes; crisp black contour and clean cel shading, rounded natural anatomy. Do not trace pixel stairs. The standing feet/legs from the FIRST image must remain in their source stance, not the key's raised knee. Keep both hands and both feet. Leave about 5% transparent safety margin outside all contours.  Exactly TWO arms total, one left and one right, and exactly TWO hands total. Standing worker with head facing SCREEN-RIGHT, visible eye, eyebrow, nose, mouth. BOTH elbows bent and lifted on opposite sides of the head, both hands above head, making a rounded open U/loop framing the cap with a visible gap. The screen-left hand is slightly taller, screen-right arm forms a more angular bent arch. Preserve this source overhead phase and standing legs, not the key's walking legs. Exactly two arms and two hands, two distinct offset shoes right.
